title: Which assumptions localize the finite-free model's roots?
question: Do the assumptions below imply that every root y of p_F satisfies |y-B| <= C_loc sqrt(Bd), for an absolute constant C_loc independent of d,A,B,C,D? Check the quantifiers, preserve any valid root properties, and state and justify a useful corrected claim if an assumption is missing.

definitions.degree: d is a positive integer; A,B,C,D are positive real numbers.
definitions.polynomial: p_F(y) = sum_{j=0}^d (-1)^j binom(d,j) (A)_j (C)_j D^j / [A^j C^j (B)_j (D)_j] y^j.
definitions.critical_point: A real zero of the derivative p_F'; there are none for d=1.

references.title: Jonathan Holland, A new hyperbolicity wedge and a joint semicircle limit for Jensen polynomials of Riemann's xi-function, arXiv:2608.08682v1
references.scope: Equation (69) defines the model. Compare the displayed conditions (57), Lemma 7.3 and its proof. This task considers the displayed conditions as a standalone hypothesis set.

references.title: Martinez-Finkelshtein, Morales and Perales, Real roots of hypergeometric polynomials via finite free convolution, arXiv:2309.10970v3
references.scope: Finite-free nonnegative-root, interlacing and logarithmic-mesh preservation; Propositions 2.7, 2.11 and 2.17.

references.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, Jacobi polynomials
references.scope: Jacobi hypergeometric representation; recurrence coefficients are in section 18.9.
